findings.reason: the guard as specified admits exactly the restates_equation=False restatement it is meant to stop, and the done-when's "carries none" is discharged by insertion alone, so no test can show the false branch is enforced; the validation needs an explicit "must carry no display equation where restates_equation is false" arm.
findings.text: §6's validation refines a document only when its display equation "is not that concept's canonical form or ... matches one of its `forbidden_variants`", so a document that carries the canonical flux-surface-average equation passes validation even though §6's own insertion rule ("where it is false ... the documentation names the concept and links to it") and its done-when ("for the flux-surface average it carries none") both require that no equation be present
